theme_strategy.theme_support: Light and Dark mode toggle with CSS custom variables (--st-bg, --st-surface, --st-border, --st-text, --st-muted, --panel-bg, --panel-surface)

runtime_branding.rule: NO hardcoded brand names or logos in images/CSS. Accent color dynamically applied via CSS variable at runtime.

font_families.mono: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

spacing_and_layout.max_width: 1200px centered container for storefront, full fluid layout for panel

narrative_flow: 1. Header: Brand mark, brand name, 'Anti-Red Hosting' subtitle, Language switcher, Theme toggle, and 'Already a customer? Sign in' quick-link.

2. Hero Section (Hook): 5-second clarity. H1 headline ('Bulletproof Anti-Red Hosting'), subheadline ('Buy hosting, pay with crypto, get instant access — no Telegram needed.'), Anti-Red explainer badge, dominant primary CTA button ('Explore Plans ↓' / 'Get Hosting Now'), and an interactive brand-neutral Hero Graphic (CSS/SVG Animated Server Shield Matrix with live ping/status ticks).
3. Live Stats / Trust Bar: Aggregate metrics bar directly below hero (e.g., 14,200+ Sites Hosted, 45,000+ Orders Delivered, 99.9% Verified Uptime, 3+ Years Running).

4. Pain → Solution Feature Grid: Interactive comparison grid highlighting 'Standard Hosting' vs 'Anti-Red Hosting' (Domain reputation shielding, zero telegram bans, instant automated cPanel provisioning, guest crypto checkout).

5. Pricing Plans Section: 3 distinct plan cards (1-Week $30/wk, 1-Month HostPanel $75/mo, Golden HostPanel $100/mo featured with 'Most Popular' amber highlight and primary glow CTA). Includes GuestBuyModal integration.
6. Customer Proof & Metrics: Verified user metrics & real order proof statistics with instant replacement guarantee callout.
7. Compact Sign-In Card ('Already a customer?'): Relocated secondary sign-in section with smooth anchor navigation, featuring Email/HostPanel Username + PIN login, Telegram login deep-link + QR code.
8. FAQ Accordion: Collapsible FAQ section addressing Crypto payments, Domain pointing, Anti-Red guarantees, and HostPanel setup.
9. Closing Call-To-Action (Final Pitch): Full-width high-converting banner with single primary action button ('Launch Your Anti-Red Site Now').
10. Footer: Brand mark, copyright, quick links, support handle (@NomadlySupport / brand support link), language selector, and system status indicator.

header_improvements.desktop: Brand mark, Brand name, visit website domain link, 'Buy more' store shortcut, language switcher, theme toggle, user pill, logout button.
header_improvements.mobile: Compact single-row header with collapsed domain link, icon-based 'Buy more' and theme toggles to prevent line wrapping on 390px screens.

tabs_navigation.overview_tab_addition: Added 'Overview' (site status, expiry date, connected domains, and quick action cards: Upload Files, Add Domain, Open Website, Renew/Upgrade Plan).
tabs_navigation.mobile_tab_bar: Horizontally scrollable tab bar with full text labels + SVG icons, custom scrollbar hiding, and subtle fade indicator arrows/shadow on right edge to signal horizontal scroll.

hosting_panel_architecture.page_titles: Dynamic tab title banner at top of main content area (e.g. 'Site Overview', 'File Manager', 'Domain Management') for scanability.
hosting_panel_architecture.file_manager_onboarding: Compact onboarding box with inline code snippet formatting (`.zip file`, `index.html`) using white-space nowrap to prevent awkward single-word line breaks.

testing_and_accessibility.testing_attributes: All buttons, links, inputs, cards, tabs, and status badges MUST maintain exact data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='storefront', data-testid='store-plan-gold', data-testid='panel-tab-overview', data-testid='store-auth-card').
testing_and_accessibility.accessibility: Touch targets >= 44px, contrast ratio >= 4.5:1, semantic HTML tags (<header>, <nav>, <main>, <section>, <article>, <footer>).

instructions_to_main_agent: Use custom CSS variables and custom `store-*` / `panel-*` CSS classes in store.css / panel.css.
Maintain strict multi-brand capability by using brand.brandName and var(--brand-accent).
Ensure both Light Mode and Dark Mode render cleanly with high contrast and zero text collisions.
Ensure Guest checkout modal (GuestBuyModal) and Crypto payment polling (CryptoPayBox) remain fully functional.
Verify mobile responsiveness down to 390px viewport width.
